children: Spanish industrial prices rose 13.2% in the 12 months through August following a 9.4% increase in the 12 months through July, the National Statistics Institute (INE) said on Thursday.
INE revised up the July figure from an initial 9.2% increase.
Industrial prices rose 2.9% in August from July, INE said.
